fields.description: The site's public address, which is also its name. The regional proxy derives it from the machine, so it is settled the moment the machine has one.
fields.label: Site Name

fields.description: The single label the customer named this site. Their address is this label in the machine's own zone; the site's own name stays ours.
fields.label: Subdomain

fields.description: The team that owns this site.
fields.label: Team

fields.description: The machine this site runs on. A site has no state of its own: its status, region and size are all the machine's.
fields.label: Server

fields.description: The first time Central confirmed that the site answered on its public address.
fields.label: Ready At

fields.description: The first time Central created a working login handoff for this site.
fields.label: Claimed At

fields.description: The accepted Pilot task for the physical site rename. An ID does not confirm completion.
fields.label: Rename Task

fields.description: The latest status reported by Pilot for the physical site rename.
fields.label: Rename Status

fields.description: When Central confirmed that Pilot completed the physical site rename.
fields.label: Rename Completed At

fields.description: When Central first reached the customer's subdomain. This does not confirm the physical rename.
fields.label: Renamed At

fields.description: A safe summary of the latest site rename failure.
fields.label: Rename Error

fields.description: The traceback of the latest site rename failure. Operators only.
fields.label: Rename Diagnostic

fields.description: The product the customer signed up for. Empty for a plain trial.
fields.label: Product

fields.description: Active runs free until the end date. Ended means the server is stopped and is terminated on the deletion date. Converted means the team added a payment method. Deleted means the trial ended without one. Empty for a site that is not a trial.
fields.label: Trial State

fields.description: The day the trial ends and its server stops.
fields.label: Trial Ends On

fields.description: The day an ended trial's server is terminated.
fields.label: Trial Deletes On

fields.description: The last trial email sent for this site, so the daily job sends each one once.
fields.label: Trial Last Notice

fields.description: The paid plan the customer chose to keep the site on. The server moves to it when the trial converts. Empty means the cheapest plan the site may move to.
fields.label: Conversion Plan

fields.description: What the free trial cost: the plan's monthly rate for the days the trial ran. Set when the trial converts or is deleted.
fields.label: Trial Cost

fields.description: Why the daily trial job could not stop or terminate the server. It retries the next day.
fields.label: Trial Error
